column1: # p289 — 2026-10-18 — EVERY PAYLOAD READ FIRST-HAND on an `ls-remote --symref`-resolved ref.
# Graded by `compose/code/p289-restatement-authority/probe.sh` (18-path ladder, British AND
# American spellings, EVERY rung that answers 200 recorded -- the probe never stops at the
# first hit, because a dual-licensed curriculum repo graded on its first 200 gets filed under
# its CODE licence while the DATA it exists to publish sits under another one).
# classification   AUTHORITATIVE-BODY  the payload IS the licence; the body travels with the clone
#                  RESTATEMENT         the licensee's paraphrase of a licence authored elsewhere
#                  BARE-REFERENCE      a name and a link, no operative terms
#                  NO-GRANT            neither
# attribution      SINGLE | DISAGREEMENT | NONE  -- how many DIFFERENT required attribution
#                                                  forms the one payload prescribes
# body_vs_summary  does the friendly summary state the SAME obligation as the terms above it?
# 🔵 THE SPLIT IS THE FINDING: the CODE is verifiable and the DATA is not.

#   AUTHORITATIVE-BODY  5   (all MIT -- the code layer)
#   RESTATEMENT         2   (both OGL v3.0 -- the CURRICULUM DATA layer, 50 948 key learning
#                            points, 11 207 misconceptions, National Curriculum for England 2014)
#   DISAGREEMENT        2   both restated payloads prescribe TWO different attributions
#   SUMMARY diverges    3 of 3 files that HAVE a summary block
# ---- THE TWO VERBATIM ATTRIBUTION CONFLICTS, with line numbers ----
# DATA-LICENSE.md L19  > Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
# DATA-LICENSE.md L54  * ⚠️ Must provide attribution: "Oak National Academy"
# LICENSE.md      L27  - ⚠️ Acknowledge the source with the attribution: "Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0."
# LICENSE.md      L67  When using this work, please credit **"Oak National Academy"**.
# CODE-LICENSE.md L38  **Attribution:** When using this work, please credit **"Oak National Academy"**
#                      ...over a VERBATIM MIT body whose own condition is the copyright-and-
#                      permission notice.  MIT does not require a credit string.
# ---- SELF-DESCRIPTION ----
# LICENSE.md advertises DATA-LICENSE.md as the "Full OGL 3.0 License".  It is a RESTATEMENT.
# `self_description_verdict()` -> OVERSTATED.
# ---- BLIND RE-MEASURE OF TWO CARRIED ROWS (p269's corroboration arm) ----
# oak-ai-lesson-assistant LICENSE   shelf claimed 1 077 B / d150aadcccd2  -> REPRODUCED EXACTLY

# 🟢 "exploit the information commercially and non-commercially ... by including it in your
#    own product or application" -- COMMERCIAL USE IS EXPLICIT.  This CONFIRMS, from payload,
#    a claim these shelves have carried since pass 5 on BRITISH EDUCATION PRESS alone.
# 🔴 "This licence is governed by the laws of England and Wales" is a CHOICE-OF-LAW clause and
#    NOT a territorial restriction.  There is NO UK-only term anywhere in the payload.  This
#    REFUTES the "indicios de restricción geográfica al Reino Unido" reservation this base has
